description: This file defines a class 'Log' within the Opencart System Library namespace, responsible for logging messages to a file. It includes methods for constructing the log object with a specific filename and writing messages to that log.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A class for creating and writing log entries to a specified file within the OpenCart system library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Log object with the specified filename, setting the log file path.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a message to the log file, appending a timestamp.
